You said:
ITS STILL THE SAME

ChatGPT said:

The problem is not the image size.
The real problem is this line in your CSS:

CSS
.diamond{
    overflow:hidden;
    width:200px;
    height:200px;
    margin:auto;
}

Your diamond container is 200×200, but the image inside is rotated 45°, which makes it appear smaller and misaligned compared to the other cards.

✅ Correct Fix (only change the diamond block)

Replace your diamond CSS with this:

CSS
.diamond{
    width:200px;
    height:200px;
    margin:auto;
    transform: rotate(45deg);
    overflow:hidden;
}

.diamond img{
    width:280px;
    height:280px;
    object-fit:cover;
    transform: rotate(-45deg);
}

Why this works

We rotate the container, not the image.

So now:

  • container → rotated 45° (diamond shape)

  • image → rotated back -45° (looks straight)

Result:

  • same visual size as other cards

  • diamond shape remains

  • middle block becomes perfectly aligned

⭐ After this the layout will look like
